tools.name: restaurantdoctor_get_questions
tools.description: Lists the 12 multiple-choice questions of the free restaurant profit check, with the answer values each one accepts. Money ranges, delivery apps and review sites follow the restaurant's country (default US).

tools.name: restaurantdoctor_run_free_check
tools.description: Scores a restaurant's 12 answers against industry benchmarks for its type of restaurant and returns the free result the website shows: an overall grade, grades by area, the estimated yearly profit leak, the biggest leak or opportunity and the first fix.
